name: Cable Hip Abduction
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to your outer leg and the cable to a low pulley, then stand sideways to the machine, holding a support.
Lift your outer leg out to the side, keeping your leg straight and your torso upright.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with the body turned 90 degrees so the side faces the cable machine, one hand lightly holding the machine for balance, an ankle cuff on the leg farther from the machine, that leg beside the other foot.
